plan: SEARCH ac_bot_knowledge_binding USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_ac_bot_knowledge_binding_1 (avernet_tenant=? AND env=? AND bot_pk=?)
SEARCH ac_bot_publish USING INDEX idx_publish_current_source (env=? AND source_bot_pk=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
sql:
SELECT ac_bot_knowledge_binding.kb_id AS ac_bot_knowledge_binding_kb_id 
FROM ac_bot_knowledge_binding 
WHERE ac_bot_knowledge_binding.bot_pk = ? AND ac_bot_knowledge_binding.env = ? AND ac_bot_knowledge_binding.space_id = ? AND ac_bot_knowledge_binding.online_enabled IS 1 AND coalesce((SELECT JSON_EXTRACT(JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ac_bot_publish.ext, ?)), ?) = ? AND coalesce(JSON_EXTRACT(JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ac_bot_publish.ext, ?)), ?), ?) = ? AS anon_1 
FROM ac_bot_publish 
WHERE ac_bot_publish.source_bot_pk = ? AND ac_bot_publish.env = ? AND ac_bot_publish.owner_id = ? AND JSON_EXTRACT(JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ac_bot_publish.ext, ?)), ?) IN (?, ?) ORDER BY coalesce(JSON_EXTRACT(JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ac_bot_publish.ext, ?)), ?), ?) DESC, ac_bot_publish.id DESC
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?), ?) = 1 AND ac_bot_knowledge_binding.avernet_tenant = ? ORDER BY ac_bot_knowledge_binding.kb_id
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
